title: 第178章 倒是合我眼缘第177章 如省
lines: 赫拉身一变，化作塞墨勒的乳母贝罗埃，悄无声息地潜入了王宫内殿。
那副苍老的面容和佝偻的身躯，与她本尊那高贵冷艳的气质判若两人。
“公主殿下，您一个人在呢？”
赫拉推门而入，真如乳母般慈祥与温和道。
“啊！奶娘，你可算来了。”
见是自家乳母，塞墨勒面上一喜，赶忙迎了上来。
往日里，这位乳母总能为她出谋划策，而眼下，身陷绝境的塞墨勒最需要的，恰恰就是这份局外人的智慧。
“奶娘，像以前那样，快帮我想想办法吧。我现在脑子里乱成了一锅粥，急需你的指点。”
面对塞墨勒的哀求，赫拉在心中权衡了片刻。
她那双藏在苍老伪装下的眼眸仔细打量着眼前的女子，看着她那副六神无主的模样，看着她眼中那真诚的悔意与恐惧，
随后，赫拉抱着对这即将受罚的可怜虫施予最后一点慈悲的心态，微微点了点头。
“那是自然。好孩子，把你的烦心事跟奶娘念叨念叨。”
听着塞墨勒将事情的原委一五一十地吐露出来，赫拉眼中闪过一丝诧异。
往常那些沾惹了宙斯的人，少有能这么快认清局势，主动寻思着怎么谢罪求生的。
可眼前的塞墨勒，居然已经在实打实地盘算退路了。
“奶娘，你也知道我这次是闯了大祸。起初我还没转过弯来，得亏父亲点醒，我现在只想知道，若是我现在向赫拉娘娘虔诚谢罪，是否还能求得一线生机？只是苦于寻不到门路啊。”
说到这里，她幽幽地叹了口气，继续道：
“父亲说，他准备向赫拉娘娘的神殿捐献一笔巨资，并大摆祭坛。
可我这心里总是不踏实，整夜整夜地合不上眼，总琢磨着，单凭这些，真的能平息天后娘娘的怒火吗......”
身为“乳母”听完了塞墨勒的这番心声，赫拉对她以及卡德摩斯王的反应，不免感到有些宽慰。
以前她见多了依仗着主神宙斯的势头，就变得不可一世、嚣张跋扈的家伙。
那些最下作的凡人、仙女乃至下位女神，仗着宙斯的宠幸便目中无人，浑然不知自己已经踩在了刀尖上。
如今冷不丁瞧见塞墨勒和卡德摩斯王这般诚惶诚恐，规矩本分的做派，赫拉那颗冰冷的心，竟是微微有些动摇了。
‘不过是一个凡人该有的本分，竟也能让我动了恻隐之心......’
赫拉在心底自嘲地叹了口气，但最终还是决定收回几分杀心。
她原本的计划是化作乳母挑唆这蠢货，引她自取灭亡。如今心念一转，这说辞便变了味儿：
“嗯......这确实是个死局。不过，我曾听闻，以前有一位女子为了平息赫拉娘娘的怒火，没日没夜地虔诚苦修，最终当真求得了宽恕。”
“那我是否也该效仿此法？”
“与其在这死守，依我看，你不如先启程去一趟德尔斐，求一纸神谕如何？
既然陛下与公主都诚心悔过，赫拉娘娘那边，说不得也会给你们留有一丝缓刑的余地。”
塞墨勒听了乳母的提议，深思熟虑了片刻，随后面色凝重地点了点头，当即开始收拾行装。
涉及神明的事，容不得半点拖延，这个道理她还是懂的。
“奶娘，多亏了你。没错，与其在这里坐以待毙，确实该先探明神意。”
content_en:
Hera transformed into Beloe, Semele's wet nurse, and quietly sneaked into the inner palace of the palace.
Her old face and stooped body were completely different from her noble and cool temperament.
"Your Highness, are you alone?"
Hera pushed the door open and spoke as kindly and gently as a wet nurse.
"Ah! Nurse, you're finally here."
Seeing that it was his wet nurse, Semele was overjoyed and hurriedly came to greet her.
In the past, this wet nurse could always give her advice, but now, what Semele needs most in a desperate situation is precisely this outsider's wisdom.
"Nanny, just like before, please help me think of a solution. My mind is in a mess now and I urgently need your guidance."
Facing Semele's plea, Hera weighed it in her mind for a moment.
Her eyes hidden under the old disguise carefully looked at the woman in front of her, looking at her helpless look, looking at the sincere regret and fear in her eyes,
Then, Hera nodded slightly with the mentality of showing her last mercy to the poor guy who was about to be punished.
"That's natural. Good boy, tell the wet nurse about your troubles."
"Oh, that's it..."
Listening to Semele telling the whole story, a trace of surprise flashed in Hera's eyes.
Those who have offended Zeus rarely recognize the situation so quickly and actively think about how to apologize and survive.
But Semele in front of him was actually planning a retreat.
"Nanny, you also know that I got into a big trouble this time. I didn't turn around at first, but my father woke me up. Now I just want to know, if I sincerely apologize to Hera, can I still have a chance of survival? It's just that I can't find a way out."
Having said this, she sighed quietly and continued:
"My father said that he was going to donate a huge sum of money to the temple of Hera and set up a large altar.
But my heart is always uneasy, and I can’t close my eyes all night long, always wondering, can these alone really calm the anger of the Queen of Heaven..."
As a "wet nurse", after hearing what Semele had to say, Hera couldn't help but feel a little relieved by her and King Cadmus's reaction.
In the past, she had seen many people who relied on the momentum of the main god Zeus to become arrogant and domineering.
The most despicable mortals, fairies and even lower-level goddesses, relying on Zeus's favor, became arrogant, unaware that they had stepped on the edge of a knife.
Now that Leng Buding saw Semele and King Cadmus acting in such a frightened manner, Hera's cold heart was slightly shaken.
'It's just the duty that a mortal should have, but it can actually make me feel compassionate...'
Hera sighed mockingly in her heart, but finally decided to take back some of her murderous intentions.
Her original plan was to turn into a wet nurse and instigate this idiot to lead her to her own destruction. Now that my mind has changed, this rhetoric has changed:
"Well... this is indeed a dead end. However, I have heard that there was a woman who practiced devoutly day and night in order to appease the anger of Hera, and finally truly begged for forgiveness."
"Then should I follow suit?"
"Instead of sticking around here, I think it's better for you to go to Delphi and ask for an oracle.
Since your majesty and the princess have sincerely repented, Hera will probably give you some room for reprieve. "
Semele listened to the wet nurse's suggestion, thought deeply for a moment, then nodded solemnly, and immediately started packing.
When it comes to matters involving the gods, there is no room for delay. She still understands this truth.
"Nanny, thank you. Yes, instead of sitting here and waiting to die, we really should find out God's will first."
